source.name: WWE.com - Tickets for Royal Rumble 2026 in Riyadh on sale now
source.note: Royal Rumble 2026 (31 Jan 2026, KAFD, Riyadh - first Royal Rumble outside North America) presented by the General Entertainment Authority and Riyadh Season in cooperation with WWE, under the leadership of HE Turki Alalshikh; also confirms WrestleMania 43 for Riyadh in 2027.

note: GEA/Riyadh Season is WWE's Saudi event host under the partnership expanded 4 Nov 2019 through 2027 (F4W Online, 2019-11-04, https://www.f4wonline.com/wwe-news/wwe-announces-expanded-partnership-saudi-arabia-296556, opened via web.archive.org). Host fee not published. Record kept at organisation level because the event-host shape has no schema yet.
